items.title: Arthur Davis and Andy Mosley Interview, 1960-01-12
items.q: Interviewer mentions Mr. Howard as a professor who appeared on the show, but the interviewee does not claim any personal interaction or relationship with him.

ctx.x: Right on the cover there. Yes, sir. This other fellow was in on this record?

No, sir. He wasn't in on that one because I was clear that when he came, he was about the third or fourth appearance that Mr. Howard, the professor, that came here. That was his first appearance when this Lou Zander sang that song.
That was his first appearance when he was in on the background. Nothing but my hammer boy. I'm a ring. Well, nothing but my hammer boy. I'm a ring.
